ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v8p183/r6.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v8p183/r6.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v8p183/r6.claim: The threat means they will expel Lot as they expelled earlier people who forbade the act, or any dissenter whatever the issue.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v8p183/r6.anchor: ودل قوله: من المخرجين على أنه سبق من نهاهم عن ذلك، فنفوه بسبب النهي

RAZI-FULL:v24p138#2/r5.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v24p138#2/r5.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v24p138#2/r5.claim: The threat means that Lot would be among those expelled from their town; they may have driven people out in the worst possible conditions.
RAZI-FULL:v24p138#2/r5.anchor: أي لتكونن من جملة من أخرجناه من بلدنا

BURSEVI:v6p219#2/r1.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v6p219#2/r1.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v6p219#2/r1.claim: Lot’s people threaten him to stop condemning and denouncing their conduct.
BURSEVI:v6p219#2/r1.anchor: أي : عن تقبيح أمرنا وإنكارك علينا

BURSEVI:v6p219#2/r2.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v6p219#2/r2.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v6p219#2/r2.claim: They threaten to expel him from the town violently and disgracefully, as one marked for exile.
BURSEVI:v6p219#2/r2.anchor: {لتكونن من المخرجين} من المعهودين بالنفي والإخراج من القرية على عنف وسوء حال.

STUDYQURAN:26:167/r1.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:26:167/r1.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:26:167/r1.claim: The threat to expel Lot is cross-referenced with the parallel account at 7:82.
STUDYQURAN:26:167/r1.anchor: If you cease not, O Lot, you will be among those

TABATABAI:26:167-175/r2.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:26:167-175/r2.speaker: author
TABATABAI:26:167-175/r2.claim: They threaten to expel Lot from their town, as their other statement makes explicit: drive Lot's family out of the town.
TABATABAI:26:167-175/r2.anchor: أي المبعدين المنفيين من قريتنا كما نقل عنهم في موضع آخر

TABATABAI:26:167-175/r4.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:26:167-175/r4.speaker: author
TABATABAI:26:167-175/r4.claim: Lot answers their threat without addressing it, signaling that he does not fear exile; he despises their deed and wants to escape its inevitable punishment.
TABATABAI:26:167-175/r4.anchor: يفيد من المعنى أني لا أخاف الخروج من قريتكم ولا أكترث به

THALABI:v7p177/r1.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v7p177/r1.speaker: author
THALABI:v7p177/r1.claim: Lot's people are transgressors because they go beyond what is lawful to what is forbidden.
THALABI:v7p177/r1.anchor: بل أنتم قوم عادون مجاوزون الحلال إلى الحرام

WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p112/r1.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p112/r1.speaker: author
WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p112/r1.claim: Here it means if Lot does not stop speaking.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p112/r1.anchor: لئن لم تنته} لئن لم تسكت

WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p112/r2.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p112/r2.speaker: author
WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p112/r2.claim: They threaten to expel Lot from their town and village.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p112/r2.anchor: لتكونن من المخرجين} من بلدتنا وقريتنا

WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p112/r3.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p112/r3.speaker: author
WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p112/r3.claim: The threat parallels what the people told Shuʿayb in 7:88.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p112/r3.anchor: كقولهم لشعيب: {لنخرجنك يا شعيب والذين آمنوا معك من قريتنا}

WAHIDI-WAJIZ:26:165-168/r4.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:26:165-168/r4.speaker: author
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:26:165-168/r4.claim: They threaten to drive Lot out of their town if he does not stop.

YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p520/r2.author: Yaḥyā b. Sallām
YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p520/r2.speaker: author
YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p520/r2.claim: They threaten to expel Lot from their town, meaning they will kill him and carry him out dead.
YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p520/r2.anchor: {قالوا لئن لم تنته يا لوط لتكونن من المخرجين} [الشعراء: 167] من قريتنا، أي: نقتلك، فنخرجك منها قتيلا.

ELMALILI:26:160-175/r5.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:26:160-175/r5.speaker: author
ELMALILI:26:160-175/r5.claim: They threaten to expel Lūṭ if he does not stop.
ELMALILI:26:160-175/r5.anchor: vazgeçmezsen yâ Lût, mutlak ve muhakkak çıkarılanlardan olacaksın” (167).

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:26:167/r1.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:26:167/r1.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:26:167/r1.claim: The people threaten Lot that if he does not stop, he too will be expelled.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:26:167/r1.anchor: Bu tutumundan vazgeçmezsen iyi bil ki sen de kovulacaksın

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-5-english:p441/r6.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-5-english:p441/r6.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-5-english:p441/r6.claim: Their wording makes the threat a decisive warning, not an empty threat; although they had threatened earlier, this time they meant to carry it out.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-5-english:p441/r6.anchor: The style of this threat clearly shows that it was not merely a threat: it was a decisive warning.

NASHR:v1p222/r1.author: Ibn al-Jazarī
NASHR:v1p222/r1.speaker: author
NASHR:v1p222/r1.claim: Mīm is nasal; avoid emphatic coloring when it is vocalized, especially before emphatic letters or alif. Its ghunna comes from the nose when it is assimilated or sākin.
NASHR:v1p222/r1.anchor: والميم: حرف أغن وتظهر غنته من الخيشوم إذا كان مدغما

NASHR:v1p222/r2.author: Ibn al-Jazarī
NASHR:v1p222/r2.speaker: author
NASHR:v1p222/r2.claim: A sākin mīm is assimilated with ghunna before another mīm, as in doubled mīm forms.
NASHR:v1p222/r2.anchor: بالغنة عند ميم مثله كإدغام النون الساكنة عند الميم

NASHR:v1p222/r3.author: Ibn al-Jazarī
NASHR:v1p222/r3.speaker: author
NASHR:v1p222/r3.claim: Before bāʾ, al-Dani, Ibn Mujahid, and western performance traditions prefer hiding the sākin mīm with ghunna; others, including Makki, and eastern traditions choose full izhar. The author accepts both but prefers ikhfāʾ; Ahmad ibn Yaqub reports consensus for izhar.
NASHR:v1p222/r3.anchor: والوجهان صحيحان مأخوذ بهما، إلا أن الإخفاء أولى للإجماع على إخفائها عند القلب

NASHR:v1p222/r4.author: Ibn al-Jazarī
NASHR:v1p222/r4.speaker: author
NASHR:v1p222/r4.claim: A sākin mīm is pronounced clearly before all remaining letters; take particular care before fāʾ or wāw, keeping it still rather than letting the tongue hide or vocalize it.
NASHR:v1p222/r4.anchor: إظهارها عند باقي الأحرف نحو: (الحمد، وأنعمت، وهم يوقنون

QIRAAT-ER:26:167:11#1/r1.author: QIRAAT-ER
QIRAAT-ER:26:167:11#1/r1.speaker: Ḥafṣ
QIRAAT-ER:26:167:11#1/r1.claim: The standard Ḥafṣ form is a passive participle from Form IV kh-r-j, and the source says it is universal across major transmissions.
QIRAAT-ER:26:167:11#1/r1.anchor: standard Hafs reading — passive participle Form IV kh-r-j (mukhraj from ʾakhraja)

SIBAWAYH:(هذابابms925ماتقلبفيهالسينصاداف.author: Sībawayh
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابms925ماتقلبفيهالسينصاداف.speaker: author
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابms925ماتقلبفيهالسينصاداف.claim: When qāf follows sīn in the same word, some speakers replace sīn with ṣād, as in صقت and صبقت, because qāf's retracted articulation pulls it upward.
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابms925ماتقلبفيهالسينصاداف.anchor: تقلبها القاف إذا كانت بعدها في كلمة واحدة وذلك نحو صقت وصبقت

SIBAWAYH:(هذابابms925ماتقلبفيهالسينصاداف.author: Sībawayh
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابms925ماتقلبفيهالسينصاداف.speaker: author
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابms925ماتقلبفيهالسينصاداف.claim: Ṣād is chosen because it is the closest match to qāf's upward articulation; this resembles ط in مصطبر and د in مزدجر, despite intervening sounds.
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابms925ماتقلبفيهالسينصاداف.anchor: من موضع السين أشبه الحروف بالقاف

SIBAWAYH:(هذابابms925ماتقلبفيهالسينصاداف.author: Sībawayh
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابms925ماتقلبفيهالسينصاداف.speaker: author
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابms925ماتقلبفيهالسينصاداف.claim: The intervening sounds do not block the shift; Sībawayh compares it with imāla of alif in forms such as صار, طار, and غزا.
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابms925ماتقلبفيهالسينصاداف.anchor: جعلوه بمنزلة عالم وإنما فعلوا هذا

SIBAWAYH:(هذابابms925ماتقلبفيهالسينصاداف.author: Sībawayh
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابms925ماتقلبفيهالسينصاداف.speaker: author
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابms925ماتقلبفيهالسينصاداف.claim: Ḫāʾ and ġayn act like qāf in this process, as in صالغ for سالغ and صلخ for سلخ.

SIBAWAYH:(هذابابms925ماتقلبفيهالسينصاداف.author: Sībawayh
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابms925ماتقلبفيهالسينصاداف.speaker: author
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابms925ماتقلبفيهالسينصاداف.claim: No parallel shift occurs with zāy before qāf: zāy is voiced and does not rise like voiceless ṣād.
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابms925ماتقلبفيهالسينصاداف.anchor: زقا أو زلق لم تغيرها لأنها

SIBAWAYH:(هذابابms925ماتقلبفيهالسينصاداف.author: Sībawayh
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابms925ماتقلبفيهالسينصاداف.speaker: بنو العنبر
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابms925ماتقلبفيهالسينصاداف.claim: Banu al-Anbar say صاطع, with ṣād before ṭāʾ, since ṭāʾ shares the upward articulation and is closer.

SIBAWAYH:(هذابابms925ماتقلبفيهالسينصاداف.author: Sībawayh
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابms925ماتقلبفيهالسينصاداف.speaker: author
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابms925ماتقلبفيهالسينصاداف.claim: Sīn and ṣād match in voicelessness, whistling, and frication; the sound changes to a counterpart matching in all features except emphatic articulation.

SIBAWAYH:(هذابابms925ماتقلبفيهالسينصاداف.author: Sībawayh
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابms925ماتقلبفيهالسينصاداف.speaker: author
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابms925ماتقلبفيهالسينصاداف.claim: The proposed ذ-to-ظ shift is rejected: ذ is less close to qāf, and the sīn shift is already exceptional; tāʾ and thāʾ likewise lack the same conditions before dāl.

ALUSI-FULL:v19p116/r1.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v19p116/r1.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v19p116/r1.claim: They threaten Lot to stop rebuking and condemning them, or to stop claiming prophethood, calling them to faith, and objecting to their conduct.
ALUSI-FULL:v19p116/r1.anchor: عن توبيخنا وتقبيح أمرنا أو عما أنت عليه من دعوى الرسالة ودعوتنا إلى الايمان

ALUSI-FULL:v19p116/r2.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v19p116/r2.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v19p116/r2.claim: The threat means Lot will be among those expelled from their familiar town; they apparently expelled people who angered them for various reasons.
ALUSI-FULL:v19p116/r2.anchor: أي من المنفيين من قريتنا المعهودين وكأنهم كانوا يخرجون من غضبوا عليه

ALUSI-FULL:v19p116/r3.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v19p116/r3.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v19p116/r3.claim: Another account says they expelled people who condemned their sexual obscenity harshly, explaining why they threatened Lot this way.
ALUSI-FULL:v19p116/r3.anchor: وقيل : بسبب إنكار تلك الفاحشة من بينهم على عنف وسوء حال ولهذا هددوه عليه السلام

ALUSI-FULL:v19p116/r4.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v19p116/r4.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v19p116/r4.claim: The longer formulation 'you will be among the expelled' is more emphatic than the shorter 'we will expel you.'
ALUSI-FULL:v19p116/r4.anchor: وعدلوا عن لنخرجنك الأخصر إلى ما ذكر ولا يخفى ما في الكلام من التأكيد

BAGHAWI-FULL:v6p126/r7.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v6p126/r7.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v6p126/r7.claim: Lot's people threaten to expel him from their town.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v6p126/r7.anchor: قالوا لئن لم تنته يا لوط لتكونن من المخرجين} من قريتنا.

BAYDAWI-FULL:26:167-171/r1.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:26:167-171/r1.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:26:167-171/r1.claim: They threaten Lot to stop either what he claims or their condemnation and prohibition of their conduct.
BAYDAWI-FULL:26:167-171/r1.anchor: عما تدعيه أو عن نهينا وتقبيح أمرنا.

BAYDAWI-FULL:26:167-171/r2.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:26:167-171/r2.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:26:167-171/r2.claim: They threaten to expel Lot from their midst, likely by driving him out violently and humiliatingly.
BAYDAWI-FULL:26:167-171/r2.anchor: من المنفيين من بين أظهرنا، ولعلهم كانوا يخرجون من أخرجوه على عنف وسوء حال.

BIQAI-FULL:v5p383/r11.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v5p383/r11.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v5p383/r11.claim: They swear that if Lot does not stop his protest, they will expel him in a degrading public fashion.
BIQAI-FULL:v5p383/r11.anchor: مقسمين : { لئن لم تنته } وسموه باسمه

BIQAI-FULL:v5p383/r12.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v5p383/r12.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v5p383/r12.claim: Addressing him by name instead of an honorific is deliberately harsh and coarse.
BIQAI-FULL:v5p383/r12.anchor: وسموه باسمه جفاء غلظة فقالوا : { يا لوط }

BIQAI-FULL:v5p383/r13.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v5p383/r13.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v5p383/r13.claim: They want personally to expel this outsider to humiliate him and be rid of objections, following their custom of exiling critics; God instead brings him out honorably through angels.
BIQAI-FULL:v5p383/r13.anchor: إشارة إلى أنه غريب عندهم , وأن عادتهم المستمرة

IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p180/r1.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p180/r1.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p180/r1.claim: Like Noah’s people, Lot’s opponents threaten him, but they threaten expulsion because he was an immigrant from outside the town who had married into the community.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p180/r1.anchor: فهددوه بالإخراج من مدينتهم لأنه كان من غير أهل المدينة بل كان مهاجرا بينهم

IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p180/r2.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p180/r2.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p180/r2.claim: The construction من المخرجين is more emphatic than saying لنخرجنك, as with من المرجومين in Noah’s story.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p180/r2.anchor: وصيغة { من المخرجين } أبلغ من : لنخرجنك

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p240#3/r6.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p240#3/r6.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p240#3/r6.claim: They threaten to expel Lūṭ from his land and home; he answers simply that he detests their deed.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p240#3/r6.anchor: فتوعدوه بالإخراج من أرضه وداره فلا يتهم عند ذلك واقتصر على الإخبار بأنه قال لعملهم

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v6p140#4/r1.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v6p140#4/r1.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v6p140#4/r1.claim: They threaten Lot that if he does not stop reproaching them, they will expel him from their town.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v6p140#4/r1.anchor: أي لئن لم تسكت عن نهينا لتكونن من المخرجين من بلدنا

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p158/r1.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p158/r1.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p158/r1.claim: When Lūṭ forbade their lewd approach to males and directed them to their wives, they threatened expulsion unless he stopped preaching.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p158/r1.anchor: لما نهاهم نبي الله عن إتيانهم الفواحش، وغشيانهم الذكور، وأرشدهم إلى إتيان نسائهم

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p158/r2.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p158/r2.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p158/r2.claim: The threat meant that they would drive Lūṭ out from among them.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p158/r2.anchor: يعنون: عما جئتنا (1) به، {لتكونن من المخرجين}

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p158/r3.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p158/r3.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p158/r3.claim: Their threat echoes the people's response in 7:82: to expel Lūṭ and his followers because they claimed to be pure.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p158/r3.anchor: كما قال تعالى: {وما (2) كان جواب قومه إلا أن قالوا

MUQATIL:26:160-173/r10.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:26:160-173/r10.speaker: قوم لوط
MUQATIL:26:160-173/r10.claim: Lot’s people threaten to expel him from the town unless he stops speaking against them.
MUQATIL:26:160-173/r10.anchor: يعنى لئن لم تسكت عنا { يلوط لتكونن من المخرجين } [آية: 167] من القرية

NASAFI-FULL:v3p195#10/r1.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v3p195#10/r1.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v3p195#10/r1.claim: They tell Lot to stop condemning and reproaching their conduct.

NASAFI-FULL:v3p195#10/r2.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v3p195#10/r2.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v3p195#10/r2.claim: They threaten to expel him from among them and drive him from their town, perhaps in the harshest manner.
NASAFI-FULL:v3p195#10/r2.anchor: من جملة من أخرجناه من بين أظهرنا وطردناه من بلدنا ولعلهم كانوا يخرجون من أخرجوه على أسوأ حال
